items.title: Jimmy Cobb — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: Yeah. I knew them guys. Washington was okay back then. It was kind of busy. You could see somebody come into town every week at all them different little places they had, the theater, and the – what is it? – Benghazi or whatever that stuff was. It was a few little places that . . .
You had 7th Street, 9th Street, 14th Street, and U Street, all those . . .
